## Load Packages
``` {r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(NPSpecies)
library(tigris)

default_crs = sf::st_crs(4326)
```

``` {r read_data}
# load nps species data
nps_species_data <- NPSpecies::species %>%
  rename(unit_code = ParkCode) %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower)

# above now replaced by output of make_nps_unit_metadata.tsv script
nps_meta <- read_tsv("data/nps_unit_metadata.tsv")
```

``` {r park_boundary_data}
# only necessary if you want multipolygons of park boundaries
# otherwise, centroid lat/lon of each unit saved in data/nps_unit_metadata.tsv
park_bounds <- st_read("data/admin_bounds.gdb/") %>%
  st_transform("+proj=longlat +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84") %>%
  # cast to multipolygon so st_make_valid will work
  mutate(shape = st_cast(shape, to = "MULTIPOLYGON")) %>%
  # make valid to fix overlapping edges
  mutate(shape = st_make_valid(shape)) %>%
  mutate(centroid = st_centroid(shape, of_largest_polygon = T),
         lon = st_coordinates(centroid)[, 1],
         lat = st_coordinates(centroid)[, 2])

# map saguaro np unit boundaries
counties_az <- tigris::counties(state = "AZ")
saguaro <- park_bounds %>% 
  filter(unit_code == "SAGU")
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = counties_az, fill = "white") +
  geom_sf(data = saguaro, fill = "#d2925a") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-110, -112), ylim = c(31.5, 33))

az_units <- park_bounds %>% 
  filter(state == "AZ")

```

``` {r practice mapping}

# plot centroids of all parks
states <- tigris::states()
park_bounds_point_only <- park_bounds %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(-centroid) %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states) +
  geom_sf(data = park_bounds_point_only)
```
